scene_context.location: Old City archives — deeper redacted-stacks work section
scene_context.situation: Cyanis, Ilyra and Torren have deliberately reached the section where Nimera Pellan is working. An Ancient physical-magical barrier has enclosed her work area. Nimera is uninjured, active and still working. Normal Crown controls do not reopen it. Mirena sent the trio to consult Nimera about Cyanis's abnormal Card and bounded evidence from the unauthorized royal-seal response investigation.
scene_context.party_state: cyanis_ilyra_torren outside; nimera enclosed but safe; maevra remains in Caelora with Mirena
scene_context.card_state: Cyanis physically carries the abnormal green-and-gold Card; it remains unclassified
scene_context.presentation: economical triggered portrait scene over physical magical-fantasy Old City staging; no combat

hard_outcomes: The trio meets Nimera Pellan as a capable working scholar, not a helpless rescue target.
The group understands that the barrier is an Ancient responsive mechanism outside normal Crown archive control and that Nimera has already tried reasonable non-destructive modern approaches.
Nimera learns the bounded reason Mirena sent the trio: Cyanis's abnormal Card and the genuine royal magical authority response appearing on unauthorized orders.
No one solves or classifies the Card or royal-seal anomaly.
The characters acquire enough complementary observations to treat the barrier as a shared solvable problem.
The barrier remains closed at the end and Beat 7 owns the actual release.
